properties.Permissions: TableData "Gen. Journal Template" = rimd, TableData "Gen. Journal Batch" = rimd

procedures.name: TemplateSelection
procedures.doc: Manages template selection for journal pages based on page type and recurring journal requirements. Filters available templates and launches appropriate journal interface.

procedures.name: TemplateSelectionFromBatch
procedures.doc: Opens journal interface directly from a batch selection, bypassing template selection. Validates batch configuration and launches the appropriate journal page.

procedures.name: OpenJnl
procedures.doc: Opens journal batch with current batch name and manages batch selection logic. Handles batch validation and provides default batch creation when necessary.

procedures.name: OpenJnlBatch
procedures.doc: Opens and initializes a general journal batch with template selection and validation. Ensures proper batch setup by creating missing templates and handling batch selection logic.

procedures.name: IsBatchNoSeriesEmpty
procedures.doc: Checks if the journal batch has an empty number series configuration. Validates whether the batch requires manual document numbering or has automatic numbering configured.

procedures.name: CheckName
procedures.doc: Validates journal batch exists and gets batch configuration for the specified batch name. Ensures batch is properly configured before allowing journal operations.

procedures.name: CheckCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Validates currency code exists in the currency master data. Provides currency validation for journal line processing.

procedures.name: SetName
procedures.doc: Sets journal batch filter on journal lines and positions to first record. Configures journal line record for batch-specific operations.

procedures.name: SetJournalSimplePageModePreference
procedures.doc: Configures journal page display mode preference for the current user. Stores user preference for simple or classic view mode in journal pages.

procedures.name: GetJournalSimplePageModePreference
procedures.doc: Retrieves journal page display mode preference for the current user. Returns user preference for simple or classic view mode in journal pages.

procedures.name: GetLastViewedJournalBatchName
procedures.doc: Retrieves the last viewed journal batch name for a specific page from user preferences. Returns stored user preference for batch selection when reopening journal pages.

procedures.name: SetLastViewedJournalBatchName
procedures.doc: Stores the last viewed journal batch name for a specific page in user preferences. Updates user preference for batch selection to improve user experience on page reopening.

procedures.name: LookupName
procedures.doc: Provides journal batch lookup functionality with filtering and selection capabilities. Opens batch selection page and updates current batch name based on user selection.

procedures.name: SetJnlBatchName
procedures.doc: Opens journal batch name lookup and updates journal line batch assignment. Provides user interface for selecting and assigning journal batch to current line.

procedures.name: GetAccounts
procedures.doc: Retrieves and caches account names for display in journal lines to improve user experience. Optimizes performance by caching account names to avoid repeated database lookups.

procedures.name: CalcBalance
procedures.doc: Calculates running balance and total balance for journal lines within the current batch context. Provides balance calculations for journal line display and validation purposes.

procedures.name: GetAvailableGeneralJournalTemplateName
procedures.doc: Generates unique journal template names by checking for conflicts and incrementing names when needed. Ensures new template names are unique while maintaining meaningful naming based on template type.

procedures.name: ShowNotificationIfSpendRequestIsRequired
procedures.doc: Used from journal pages and warns users of need to specify spend request no.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetAccounts
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after retrieving account names for journal line display. Enables customization of account name lookup and display logic.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckName
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating journal batch name exists and is properly configured. Enables custom batch validation logic and post-validation processing.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetName
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting journal batch filter on journal lines. Enables custom filtering logic and post-filter processing.

procedures.name: OnAfterOpenJournalBatch
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after opening journal batch operations complete. Enables custom logic after batch and template have been selected and configured.

procedures.name: OnAfterTemplateSelection
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after template selection process completes. Enables custom logic after template selection and journal page launch.

procedures.name: OnBeforeLookupName
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before journal batch name lookup operations. Enables custom filtering or validation logic before batch selection.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetJournalSimplePageModePreference
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving journal simple page mode preference. Enables custom logic before preference retrieval.

procedures.name: OnBeforeSetJournalSimplePageModePreference
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before setting journal simple page mode preference. Enables custom validation or modification of preference settings.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOpenJnl
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before opening journal with batch name operations. Enables custom validation or preprocessing before journal opening.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOpenJnlBatch
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before journal batch opening operations. Enables custom logic to completely override batch opening process.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOpenJournalPageFromBatch
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before opening journal page from batch context. Enables custom logic to override page opening from batch selection.

procedures.name: OnBeforeRunTemplateJournalPage
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before running template journal page operations. Enables custom logic to override journal page launching.

procedures.name: OnTemplateSelectionSetFilter
procedures.doc: Integration event raised during template selection to enable custom filtering logic. Allows modification of template filters and selection criteria.

procedures.name: OnFindTemplateFromSelectionOnBeforeGenJnlTemplateInsert
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a new journal template during template selection. Enables custom template configuration before insertion.

procedures.name: OnOpenJnlOnAfterCheckTemplateName
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after template name checking during journal opening. Enables custom processing after template validation.

procedures.name: OnOpenJnlBatchOnBeforeCheckGenJnlTemplateCount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking journal template count during batch operations. Enables custom template filtering or validation logic.

procedures.name: OnAfterCalcBalance
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after balance calculation operations complete. Enables custom processing or validation after balance calculations.

procedures.name: OnCalcBalanceOnAfterCopyFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying filters during balance calculation setup. Enables custom filter modification before balance calculation processing.

procedures.name: OnCalcBalanceOnBeforeTempGenJnlLineNext
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before moving to next record during balance calculation. Enables custom record positioning logic during balance calculation.

properties.Permissions: TableData Currency = r, TableData "Cust. Ledger Entry" = rim, TableData "Vendor Ledger Entry" = rim, TableData "Gen. Journal Line" = rim, TableData "General Ledger Setup" = r

procedures.name: PmtTolCust
procedures.doc: Validates payment tolerance for customer ledger entries and shows tolerance warning if needed. Calculates tolerance amounts and displays confirmation dialog for tolerance processing.

procedures.name: PmtTolVend
procedures.doc: Validates payment tolerance for vendor ledger entries and shows tolerance warning if needed. Calculates tolerance amounts and displays confirmation dialog for tolerance processing.

procedures.name: PmtTolGenJnl
procedures.doc: Validates payment tolerance for general journal line payments. Determines if tolerance warnings should be shown for customer and vendor payments.

procedures.name: PmtTolPmtReconJnl
procedures.doc: Processes payment tolerance for bank account reconciliation lines. Determines whether payment tolerance should be applied based on account type.

procedures.name: CallPmtDiscTolWarning
procedures.doc: Displays payment discount tolerance warning dialog and handles user response. Calculates whether payment discount tolerance should be applied based on user choice.

procedures.name: CallPmtTolWarning
procedures.doc: Displays payment tolerance warning dialog and processes user response. Allows user to accept or reject payment tolerance amounts for transactions.

procedures.name: CalcGracePeriodCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Calculates and updates payment tolerance grace period for all open customer and vendor ledger entries. Processes entries that fall within the specified grace period for payment tolerance.

procedures.name: CalcTolCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Calculates payment tolerance for customer ledger entries. Updates customer ledger entries with payment tolerance amounts based on General Ledger setup and currency configuration.

procedures.name: DelTolCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Deletes payment tolerance settings for customer ledger entries. Resets payment tolerance amount and maximum payment tolerance to zero for the specified customer.

procedures.name: CalcTolVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Calculates payment tolerance for vendor ledger entries. Updates vendor ledger entries with payment tolerance amounts based on General Ledger setup and currency configuration.

procedures.name: DelTolVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Deletes payment tolerance settings for vendor ledger entries. Resets payment tolerance amount and maximum payment tolerance to zero for the specified vendor.

procedures.name: DelPmtTolApllnDocNo
procedures.doc: Deletes payment tolerance for applications with the specified document number. Removes tolerance settings from customer or vendor ledger entries based on account type in the general journal line.

procedures.name: ABSMinTol
procedures.doc: Returns the decimal value with minimum absolute value considering tolerance. Compares two decimal values and returns the one with the smaller absolute value after applying tolerance.

procedures.name: GetApplicationRoundingPrecisionForAppliesToDoc
procedures.doc: Gets application rounding precision for applies-to document currency operations. Determines rounding precision values based on applied entry and application currency codes.

procedures.name: GetAmountRoundingPrecision
procedures.doc: Gets amount rounding precision for multi-currency applications. Determines application and amount rounding precision based on currency and multi-currency settings.

procedures.name: CalcRemainingPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Calculates remaining payment discount for CV ledger entry buffers. Updates payment discount amounts and remaining payment discount possible fields based on application scenarios.

procedures.name: CalcMaxPmtTolerance
procedures.doc: Calculates maximum payment tolerance for a document. Determines payment tolerance amount based on document type, currency, amount, and General Ledger setup configuration.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for CV ledger entry buffers. Validates payment discount eligibility and calculates discount amounts based on application parameters.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscCVCust
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for CV ledger entry buffer against customer ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between CV buffer and customer entries.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscCust
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount between customer ledger entries. Validates payment discount eligibility between new and existing customer ledger entries.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscGenJnlCust
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for general journal line against customer ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between journal line and customer entry.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscCVVend
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for CV ledger entry buffer against vendor ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between CV buffer and vendor entries.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscVend
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount between vendor ledger entries. Validates payment discount eligibility between new and existing vendor ledger entries.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscGenJnlVend
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for general journal line against vendor ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between journal line and vendor entry.

procedures.name: SetSuppressCommit
procedures.doc: Sets whether database commit operations should be suppressed during payment tolerance processing. Used to control transaction behavior in batch processing scenarios.

procedures.name: SetSuppressWarning
procedures.doc: Sets whether warning dialogs should be suppressed during payment tolerance processing. Used to control user interaction during automated processing scenarios.

procedures.name: CheckAccountType
procedures.doc: Validates that the specified account type matches the account type or balance account type in the general journal line. Ensures proper account type validation for payment tolerance operations.

procedures.name: GetAppliesToID
procedures.doc: Gets the applies-to ID from the general journal line for payment application. Returns the applies-to ID if no specific document number is specified.

procedures.name: OnAfterCalcMaxPmtTolerance
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating maximum payment tolerance amount. Enables custom calculation of maximum tolerance amounts based on business rules.

procedures.name: OnAfterDelPmtTolApllnDocNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after deleting payment tolerance application document number. Enables custom cleanup operations following tolerance application removal.

procedures.name: OnAfterPmtTolGenJnl
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after processing payment tolerance for general journal lines. Enables custom post-processing logic following tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnAfterPmtTolPmtReconJnl
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after processing payment tolerance for payment reconciliation journal. Enables custom processing for bank reconciliation tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCalcMaxPmtTolerance
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating maximum payment tolerance amount. Enables custom tolerance calculation logic to override standard processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCalcRemainingPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating remaining payment discount for CV ledger entries. Enables custom payment discount calculation logic in tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCallPmtDiscTolWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before displaying payment discount tolerance warning dialog. Enables custom validation logic before showing tolerance warnings to users.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckCalcPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating and checking payment discount for CV ledger entries. Enables custom discount validation logic before standard processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckPmtDiscTolCust
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking payment discount tolerance for customer ledger entries. Enables custom validation logic for customer-specific tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckPmtDiscTolVend
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking payment discount tolerance for vendor ledger entries. Enables custom validation logic for vendor-specific tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeDelPmtTolApllnDocNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before deleting payment tolerance application document number. Enables custom validation before tolerance application removal.

procedures.name: OnBeforeRunModalPmtTolWarningCallPmtTolWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before showing modal payment tolerance warning dialog. Enables custom logic before displaying tolerance warnings to users.

procedures.name: OnCalcCustApplnAmountOnBeforeUpdateCustAmountsForApplication
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before updating customer amounts for application in tolerance scenarios. Enables custom modification of customer application amounts.

procedures.name: OnCalcCustApplnAmountOnAfterAppliedCustLedgEntryLoop
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after looping through applied customer ledger entries. Enables custom processing after customer application amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnCalcVendApplnAmountOnBeforeUpdateVendAmountsForApplication
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before updating vendor amounts for application in tolerance scenarios. Enables custom modification of vendor application amounts.

procedures.name: OnCalcVendApplnAmountOnAfterAppliedVendLedgEntryLoop
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after looping through applied vendor ledger entries. Enables custom processing after vendor application amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnCalcTolCustLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying customer ledger entry during tolerance calculations. Enables custom validation or modification before tolerance updates.

procedures.name: OnCalcTolVendLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying vendor ledger entry during tolerance calculations. Enables custom validation or modification before tolerance updates.

procedures.name: OnCalcTolCustLedgEntryOnCustLedgEntryLoopIterationStart
procedures.doc: Integration event raised at start of customer ledger entry loop iteration during tolerance calculation. Enables custom processing or skipping of specific customer entries.

procedures.name: OnGetAccountNameOnCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for custom account name resolution in tolerance scenarios. Enables custom account name determination for payment tolerance account types.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolCustOnAfterSetCustEntryApplId
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting customer entry application ID for payment tolerance. Enables custom handling of customer application identifiers.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolVendOnAfterSetVendEntryApplId
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting vendor entry application ID for payment tolerance. Enables custom handling of vendor application identifiers.

procedures.name: OnPutCustPmtTolAmountOnAfterAppliedCustLedgEntrySetFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters on applied customer ledger entries for tolerance amounts. Enables custom filter modification for customer payment tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnPutVendPmtTolAmountOnAfterVendLedgEntrySetFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters on vendor ledger entries for tolerance amounts. Enables custom filter modification for vendor payment tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnCalcGracePeriodCVLedgEntryOnBeforeCustLedgEntryModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying customer ledger entry during grace period calculations. Enables custom validation before grace period tolerance updates.

procedures.name: OnCalcGracePeriodCVLedgEntryOnBeforeVendLedgEntryModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying vendor ledger entry during grace period calculations. Enables custom validation before grace period tolerance updates.

procedures.name: OnDelTolCustLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying customer ledger entry during tolerance deletion. Enables custom validation before removing customer tolerance entries.

procedures.name: OnDelTolVendLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying vendor ledger entry during tolerance deletion. Enables custom validation before removing vendor tolerance entries.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolGenJnlOnAfterCheckConditions
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after checking conditions for payment tolerance in general journal processing. Enables custom post-validation logic following tolerance condition checks.

procedures.name: OnCalcCustApplnAmountAfterCalcRemainingAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating remaining amount in customer application scenarios. Enables custom processing following customer application amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnCalcVendApplnAmountAfterCalcRemainingAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating remaining amount in vendor application scenarios. Enables custom processing following vendor application amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnManagePaymentDiscToleranceWarningCustomerAfterCalcRemainingAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating remaining amount for customer payment discount tolerance warnings. Enables custom processing following customer discount tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnManagePaymentDiscToleranceWarningVendorAfterCalcRemainingAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating remaining amount for vendor payment discount tolerance warnings. Enables custom processing following vendor discount tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolCustBeforeCalcCustApplnAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating customer application amount in payment tolerance scenarios. Enables custom pre-processing of customer tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolVendBeforeCalcVendApplnAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating vendor application amount in payment tolerance scenarios. Enables custom pre-processing of vendor tolerance calculations.

procedures.name: OnPutCustPmtTolAmountAfterCalcAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating customer payment tolerance amount. Enables custom post-processing following customer tolerance amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnPutVendPmtTolAmountAfterCalcAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating vendor payment tolerance amount. Enables custom post-processing following vendor tolerance amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnUpdateCustAmountsForApplicationAfterCalcRemainingAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating remaining amount for customer application updates. Enables custom processing following customer amount updates for application.

procedures.name: OnUpdateVendAmountsForApplicationAfterCalcRemainingAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating remaining amount for vendor application updates. Enables custom processing following vendor amount updates for application.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolCustLedgEntryOnBeforeWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before showing warning for customer payment tolerance ledger entries. Enables custom validation and modification before displaying tolerance warnings.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolVendLedgEntryOnBeforeWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before showing warning for vendor payment tolerance ledger entries. Enables custom validation and modification before displaying vendor tolerance warnings.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckPmtTolCust
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking customer payment tolerance scenarios. Enables custom validation logic before standard customer tolerance checking.

procedures.name: OnBeforeDelCustPmtTolAcc2
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before deleting customer payment tolerance account entries. Enables custom validation before customer tolerance account deletion.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetCustPositiveFilter
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before determining customer positive filter for payment tolerance. Enables custom logic for customer positive amount filtering.

procedures.name: OnCalcGracePeriodCVLedgEntryOnAfterCustLedgEntrySetFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters on customer ledger entries during grace period calculations. Enables custom filter modification for customer grace period processing.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolCustOnAfterSetPaymentTolWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting payment tolerance warning flag in customer scenarios. Enables custom handling of payment tolerance warnings for customers.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolVendOnAfterSetPaymentTolWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting payment tolerance warning flag in vendor scenarios. Enables custom handling of payment tolerance warnings for vendors.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolCustLedgEntryOnAfterSetPaymentTolWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting payment tolerance warning flag in customer ledger entry processing. Enables custom handling of payment tolerance warnings for customer ledger entries.

procedures.name: OnPmtTolVendLedgEntryOnAfterSetPaymentTolWarning
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting payment tolerance warning flag in vendor ledger entry processing. Enables custom handling of payment tolerance warnings for vendor ledger entries.

procedures.name: Export
procedures.doc: Exports SEPA credit transfer data from general journal lines to XML format. Creates credit transfer register entry and manages file output to server or client.

procedures.name: EnableExportToServerFile
procedures.doc: Enables export to server file instead of client download.

procedures.name: OnBeforeBLOBExport
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before BLOB export operation during credit transfer file creation. Enables custom file handling or modification of export parameters.

procedures.name: OnBeforeExtport
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before starting SEPA credit transfer export process. Enables custom export handling or validation before standard processing.

procedures.name: FillExportBuffer
procedures.doc: Fills the payment export data buffer with information from general journal lines for SEPA credit transfer. Validates journal lines, retrieves bank account and recipient information, and formats data according to SEPA credit transfer standards for XML export processing.

procedures.name: OnAfterCreateNewCreditTransferEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after creating new credit transfer entry during export buffer processing. Enables custom processing or field updates after credit transfer entry creation.

procedures.name: OnAfterFillExportBuffer
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing export buffer processing for SEPA credit transfer. Enables final custom processing or validation after all export data has been populated.

procedures.name: OnFillExportBufferOnAfterGetMessageID
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after generating message ID during export buffer processing. Enables custom message ID generation or modification.

procedures.name: OnFillExportBufferOnAfterCreateNewRegister
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after creating new credit transfer register during export processing. Enables custom processing or field updates after register creation.

procedures.name: CopyJnlLines
procedures.doc: Copies eligible general journal lines to a temporary table for SEPA credit transfer processing. Processes journal lines and applies customization through integration events.

procedures.name: CreateTempJnlLines
procedures.doc: Creates temporary journal lines when no source lines are found. Allows customization through integration events for alternative data population strategies.

procedures.name: OnAfterCreateTempJnlLines
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after creating temporary journal lines. Allows subscribers to modify or enhance the temporary lines after standard processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCreateTempJnlLines
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before creating temporary journal lines. Allows subscribers to provide custom logic for temporary line creation.

procedures.name: OnCopyJnlLinesOnBeforeTempGenJnlLineInsert
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting temporary journal lines during the copy process. Allows subscribers to modify journal line data or apply custom transformations.

procedures.name: DisableRemittanceTruncationNotification
procedures.doc: Disables the remittance truncation notification for the current user.

procedures.name: SubmitDeclaration
procedures.doc: Submits tax declaration in XML format to Digipoort.

procedures.name: ReceiveResponse
procedures.doc: Receive responses messages from Digipoort.
